title: Slack Team Messaging: Complete Architecture
description: Design slack team messaging with monolith and microservice architectures using React, ASP.NET Core, Azure, and AWS.

data.text: Design a team messaging platform similar to Slack that supports workspaces, channels, direct messages, threaded conversations, file attachments, emoji reactions, mentions, and real-time presence indicators. Users expect instant message delivery, searchable history, and synchronized state across web, desktop, and mobile clients.

data.title: Functional Requirements
items: Create and manage workspaces with member roles (owner, admin, member, guest)
Create public, private, and shared channels with granular permissions
Send and receive direct messages and group messages in real-time
Support threaded replies under any message with notification to parent thread
Upload and share files (images, documents, videos) with preview support
Add emoji reactions to messages and support custom workspace emoji
Mention users with @username and notify them across email, push, and in-app
Show online, away, offline, and do-not-disturb presence status
Search messages, files, and users with filters by channel, date, and sender
Pin and star important messages; organize with message bookmarks

data.title: Non-Functional Requirements
items: Message delivery latency under 200ms for 99th percentile across geographies
99.99% availability for messaging and presence services
Support 50,000 concurrent users per workspace with sub-second channel load time
End-to-end encryption for enterprise workspace messages
Message durability with ordered persistence and exactly-once delivery semantics
Offline message sync when clients reconnect after network interruption

data.text: Start with a monolithic ASP.NET Core application that validates the Slack messaging domain: workspaces, channels, messages, presence, and file storage. This validates business rules like message ordering, channel permissions, and notification routing before splitting into services.

data.title: Monolith Tech Stack
data.code:
Frontend:
  - React 18 with TypeScript
  - Vite for build tooling
  - Tailwind CSS for styling
  - React Query for server state

Backend (ASP.NET Core):
  - Minimal API or MVC Controllers
  - Entity Framework Core for data access
  - Azure SQL Database or AWS RDS for relational data
  - Built-in DI, logging, and health checks

Infrastructure:
  - Azure App Service or AWS EC2/ECS
  - Azure Blob Storage or AWS S3 for file assets
  - Azure Monitor or AWS CloudWatch for logging
  - Single database with tables for all domains

data.text: As traffic grows, split the monolith into independently scalable microservices. Each service owns its data and communicates via async messaging or REST/gRPC.

items: Message Service: Manages channel messages, direct messages, and threaded replies with ordered persistence, message editing, deletion, and pinning. Uses a time-series data model for efficient channel history queries.
Presence Service: Tracks online, offline, away, and do-not-disturb status using Redis pub/sub for real-time status broadcasts and heartbeat timeouts to detect stale connections.

Notification Service: Handles in-app notifications, email digests, and mobile push notifications for mentions, thread replies, and channel invites. Uses a fan-out pattern to deliver to multiple devices per user.
Workspace Service: Manages workspace creation, member roles, channel permissions, and custom emoji. Enforces access control for private channels and guest users.
Search Service: Provides full-text search across messages, files, and users using Elasticsearch or Azure Cognitive Search with filters for channel, date range, sender, and has-attachment.

data.title: React App Structure
data.code:
src/
  features/
    SlackMessagingHld/
      components/
        ChannelSidebar/      # Workspace/channel list with unread badges
        MessageList/          # Virtualized message rendering with date separators
        MessageComposer/      # Rich text input with mentions, emoji, attachments
        ThreadView/           # Threaded replies panel with parent context
        PresenceBar/          # User status indicators (online/away/dnd/offline)
        SearchPanel/          # Full-text search with filters
        FilePreviewModal/     # Image/document preview with download
      hooks/
        useRealtimeMessages/  # WebSocket/SSE subscription for new messages
        useChannelPresence/   # Subscribe to member online status
        useMessageSearch/     # Debounced search with pagination
      api/
        messages.ts           # POST /channels/:id/messages, GET /channels/:id/history
        presence.ts           # GET /users/presence, POST /users/presence/heartbeat
        search.ts             # GET /search?q=&type=channel|user|file
      store/
        channelStore.ts       # Active channel, unread counts, typing indicators
        authStore.ts          # Workspace token, current user

Key Patterns:
  - Feature-based folder structure
  - API Gateway as single entry point
  - React Query for caching and background refetch
  - WebSocket / SSE for real-time message delivery and presence updates
  - Error boundaries and retry logic with optimistic UI for message sends
